description: Typed manifest for one exact TextForensics release candidate (W10): every candidate asset with its SHA-256 digest and size, the immutable source SHA it was built from, the exact build commands and build profile, the two-build byte-identity proof, and the verification material a second verifier needs to re-derive every digest from the source SHA alone. The manifest file itself is committed in the commit immediately following the source it describes (candidate.source_sha), discoverable via `git log -- docs/release/candidate-manifest.json`: the manifest is not packaged into the wheel or sdist (the sdist carries no docs/ members), so the digests it records are unaffected by the commit that adds it. A reader with only this manifest and the source SHA re-derives every digest by running the recorded build commands from a clean checkout of candidate.source_sha.

assets.description: Every candidate asset. Exactly six kinds are required: wheel, sdist, source-archive, license, license-notice, sbom (one entry per kind). Built assets (wheel, sdist, source-archive) are re-derived from candidate.source_sha; in-repo assets (license, license-notice, sbom) are verified against the recorded digests at the recorded paths.

derivation.description: Exact command (or command sequence) that re-derives this asset from candidate.source_sha. Omitted for in-repo assets, which are verified by digest, not rebuilt.

filename.description: File name of the asset (no directory).

kind.description: Asset kind. Exactly one entry per kind is required.

path.description: Repo-relative path for in-repo assets; conventional dist location (dist/<filename>) for built assets, which live outside the source tree.

role.description: What this asset is and why it belongs to the candidate.

sbom_components.description: SBOM assets only: number of components in the CycloneDX payload.

sbom_serial_number.description: SBOM assets only: the CycloneDX serialNumber (deterministic UUIDv5 derived from the content digest).

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact asset bytes.

size_bytes.description: Size of the asset in bytes.

spdx_license_id.description: License assets only: SPDX identifier of the licence the file carries.

verification.description: How this asset is verified independently (command or digest comparison).

candidate.description: Provenance of the candidate: the immutable source it was built from, the exact build profile and commands.

build_commands.description: Exact build commands, in order, that produced the candidate assets from candidate.source_sha. A second verifier runs these verbatim (with the recorded source SHA checked out) and must obtain the recorded digests.

build_profile.description: The pinned build-tool profile (ENG-10) used for both builds.

tools_lockfile.description: The hash-pinned lockfile the build profile was installed from.

notes.description: Free-form provenance notes (what was built, what was deliberately not published, known limitations of the candidate).

source_branch.description: Branch the candidate was built from.

source_date_epoch.description: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for both builds (ENG-03 deterministic build).

source_sha.description: Full commit SHA of the exact source head the candidate was built from (the head `git archive HEAD` was exported from).

reproducibility.description: The ENG-03 two-clean-builds proof: both builds from the same source SHA must be byte-identical.

builds.description: Number of independent clean builds compared.

identical.description: True only when both builds are byte-identical for wheel and sdist.

source_archive.description: The source artifact itself is re-derived twice from candidate.source_sha and must be byte-identical.

method.description: How the source artifact was produced.

verification.description: How a second verifier checks the whole candidate independently.

commands.description: Exact verification commands, in order. Every command must pass for the candidate to stand; a failure rejects the candidate.

notes.description: Verification notes (what was checked, where the retained build outputs live, what is deliberately not claimed).

title: TextForensics Release Candidate Manifest
